title: A toy model of a protein prototype reveals nontrivial ultrametricity of the energy landscape
summary: A model for studying the ultrametricity of the energy landscape in a disordered heteropolymer is presented. It is treated as a simplified model of a protein molecule in which amino acid residues are modeled as point masses. Pairwise interactions include universal repulsion, the Lennard-Jones potential, the Coulomb potential with screening, and the elastic potential for bonds between adjacent residues.
